status_statement: The unrestricted finite Erdős--Gyárfás conjecture remains open; one verified finite graph avoiding every power-of-two cycle would disprove it globally, while bounded negative search cannot prove it.
baseline_facts: The hypothesis is minimum degree at least 3; connectivity is not required.
For a candidate on at most 64 vertices the relevant forbidden simple-cycle lengths are exactly 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 when not exceeding n.
The upstream Lean declaration is only a pinned statement skeleton and contains sorry; it is not a trusted root-proof path in this target version.

known_route_baselines.result: The conjecture is proved for this subclass with computer assistance.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: A result confined to this already covered subclass is not new root or partial progress unless it materially strengthens the method or formalization.

known_route_baselines.scope: a minimum-order-and-size counterexample, if one exists
known_route_baselines.result: High-degree vertices are independent, every vertex is adjacent to a degree-3 vertex, and at least 4/7 of the vertices have degree exactly 3.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: Searches or proofs should incorporate or genuinely strengthen these structural restrictions instead of rediscovering them numerically.

known_route_baselines.scope: all finite simple graphs with minimum degree at least 3 through 31 vertices
known_route_baselines.result: A pinned public SAT/SMS project reports exhaustive exclusion through order 31.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: A general finite exclusion must go beyond 31 and preserve independently checkable evidence; the public baseline itself still merits independent reproduction.

known_route_baselines.scope: simple cubic bipartite graphs through 58 vertices
known_route_baselines.result: Certified exhaustive computation excludes counterexamples in this subclass through order 58.
known_route_baselines.research_consequence: Cubic-bipartite search at order at most 58 duplicates known work; unrestricted, non-bipartite or higher-order directions remain distinct.

verification_caveats: The exact checker accepts only explicit counterexamples on 4 to 64 vertices and may hit a deterministic search-step ceiling; that ceiling is an apparatus failure, never rejection.
A natural-language or Lean positive proof is valuable research but needs a separately designed trust boundary before formal closure.
provenance_caveats: The through-31 SAT route is recorded as a public computational baseline pending independent reproduction.
Fast-moving 2026 literature and any actual candidate require a fresh novelty/status review before a public resolution claim.
